method: Native-touch mobile engineering with arranged player/actor/cover poses on an isolated platform20m above the station, suppressed AI and explicit shutter states. Native scene taps, jitter, drags, cancel, movement, fire, menu preference and UI/storage checked. Forced result/cache fixtures are not played mission wins.

checks: native visible-body tap centres a physical surface without firing or automatic tracking
movement thumb remains owned when the aiming tap releases
empty space and foreground cover do not focus a hidden actor
a visible foreground actor receives focus and shots before a rear actor
hidden, dead and beyond36m actors cannot be selected
cancel, long hold, drag and returned drag never become a tap focus
small tap jitter is buffered while full scene drag displacement is preserved
pause cancels a held target tap and resumes with no aim or firing ownership
both weapons support focus and disabling the option restores inert taps
Custodian live shutters and exposed windings focus; dead surfaces and housing do not
tap-only assisted result uses separate best and caches the action count

failures.name: tap then native FIRE damages the actual target with normal ammunition use
an opaque HUD notice over a target prevents focus until it clears
failures.error:

1 !== 0
